295:| `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE .../accounts[/{account}]` | The server's accounts. See [Server accounts](#server-accounts) |
296:| `POST .../oauth/import-tokens` | **Deprecated.** Uploads to your default account; use `PUT .../accounts/{account}`. See [The
deprecated import route](#the-deprecated-import-route) |
298:**Eval runs** (`/projects/{projectId}/...`):
302:| `POST .../eval-suites` | Author-only: create a suite + its test cases from `name` + `serverIds` + a default `model` + `tests
`, WITHOUT running it; responds `201` + `suiteId`. Each test's case body is an ordered `steps` array (prompt / toolCall / interact
/ assert); per-test `model`/`provider`/`runs` are optional and fall back to suite defaults |
303:| `POST .../eval-runs` | Create a run from a `suiteId` (rerun; `serverIds` optional — defaults to the suite's saved servers) o
r `suiteName` + inline `tests` + `serverIds` (new suite). `environmentId` (requires `suiteId`) runs against one of the suite's att
ached environments instead. Responds `202` + `runId` |
304:| `PATCH .../eval-suites/{suiteId}` | Edit suite settings, including `environmentIds` — the project environments the suite run
s against (non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears) |
305:| `PATCH .../eval-suites/{suiteId}/schedule` | Enable/disable scheduled runs; `environmentId` pins which environment they laun
ch |
306:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}` | Run status, result, and summary — poll until terminal. Carries `gateWaiver`: the audited overr
ide in force over this run's gate, or `null` |
307:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate` | The stored suite quality-gate report for this run (`passed` / `failed` / `non_gateable` /
`not_configured`). `not_configured` is a 200 report, never a missing route. A deployment that predates the evaluator answers `422
FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED` |
308:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/decision-summary` | **Start here when a run did not pass.** The canonical run decision contract:
the verdict and where it came from, counts labelled with the population they count, the run's own verdict decision, and per-trial
diagnostics with the user-value chain, the first failed stage, the failure category, evidence scoped to that stage, and one next a
ction (paginated) |
309:| `POST .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers` | Override a **failing** run's release gate until `expiresAt` (required, future, m
ax 30 days out), with a `reason` (required, max 500 chars). Manage tier. Does NOT change the run's `result` — the run keeps its ve
rdict and the waiver is reported alongside it. `409` when one is already in force, returning the existing waiver |
310:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers` | The waiver in force over a run, or `null`. Readable by anyone who can view the ru
n |
311:| `DELETE .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers/{waiverId}` | Revoke a waiver, putting the gate back. Idempotent — a second call
reports the original revocation rather than restamping it |
312:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations` | Per-iteration results: tool calls, token usage, latency (paginated) |
313:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations/{iterationId}/trace` | Full trace: messages + expected-vs-actual analysis |
314:| `GET .../eval-suites/{suiteId}/runs` | Recent runs for a suite, newest first |
316:**Eval result ingestion** (`/projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/...`) — how `@mcpjam/sdk` saves results from eval runs executed
outside the platform (local dev, CI). The `{projectId}` segment accepts the literal `default` for the key org's Default project. M
ost users never call these directly — set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` and the [SDK reporter](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/saving-resu
lts.md) does:
320:| `POST .../eval-ingest/report` | One-shot: create a run from finished results and finalize it |
321:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/start` | Chunked flow: create (or idempotently reuse) a run by `externalRunId` |
322:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/iterations` | Append an iteration batch to a started run |
323:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/finalize` | Finalize a chunked run (idempotent) |
324:| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` | Store one artifact's raw bytes (widget HTML too large to send inline) and return its `sto
rageId` |
325:| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts/upload-url` | Retired. Answers `410 Gone` with `details.code: "SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"`. `@mcp
